findings.description: Priority 1 recommendation: generic advice to give every custom control an accessible name and correct role without referencing specific elements or counts.
Priority 2 recommendation: generic instruction to add descriptive alt text to images, lacking element selectors or instance data.
Priority 3 recommendation: generic guidance to expose form labels, not tied to particular fields or page instances.
Priority 4 recommendation: generic advice to add a skip link or landmark, without specifying the affected element or selector.
Priority 5 recommendation: generic instruction to order headings properly, no specific heading levels or page references.
Priority 6 recommendation: generic guidance to replace bare divs with semantic elements, lacking selectors or page details.
Priority 7 recommendation: generic advice to profile slow routes and cache or precompute paths, no specific URLs or metrics.
Priority 8 recommendation: generic instruction to add missing security headers site‑wide, without referencing particular responses or counts.
Priority 9 recommendation: generic advice to complete Open Graph metadata, not tied to specific pages or tags.
Priority 10 recommendation: generic instruction to add missing Schema.org properties, no element selectors or instance data.
Priority 11 recommendation: generic guidance to add required and recommended Schema.org properties, lacking specific entity references.
